response.goal: Build an n8n workflow that triggers on new responses from two Typeform forms, checks the Google Sheet for an existing row with the same email to skip duplicates, adds a new row with name, email, company, form name and timestamp, posts a short message to the #sales Slack channel with a link to the row, and emails if any step fails.

plan.step: Configure the Typeform triggers in n8n for both demo request forms to capture new responses
Query the Google Sheet to check for an existing row with the same email address and implement duplicate check logic
Add a new row to the Google Sheet containing name, email, company, form name and timestamp if the email is not a duplicate
Post a short message to the #sales Slack channel including a link to the newly created row
Configure error handling in n8n to send an email notification if any step fails

milestones.name: Phase 1: Workflow Setup and Duplicate Check
milestones.deliverable: Configured Typeform triggers and Google Sheets duplicate check and row insertion logic in n8n

milestones.name: Phase 2: Slack Alerts and Error Handling
milestones.deliverable: Configured Slack channel alerts with row links and error notification emails

risks.risk: Typeform payload structure differences between the two forms
risks.mitigation: Map and normalize the data fields from both Typeform forms into a unified schema in n8n before processing.

risks.risk: Hourly billing structure without a total fixed price cap
risks.mitigation: Establish a weekly hour cap and provide regular progress updates to stay within expected budget ranges.

questions: What email service or node do you prefer to use for the failure notification emails?

assumptions: The client has a self-hosted n8n instance up and running with necessary access.
The Google Sheet already has the correct column headers set up for name, email, company, form name, and timestamp.
